ModMetaData.name: HSK Zero Research Start
ModMetaData.author: Sonsalt
ModMetaData.description:
Start a Hardcore SK colony with no research finished.
- Scenarios "Lost Tribe (no research)" and "Crashlanded (no research)": HSK's scenarios with player factions that get no starting research or techprints. - Factions "new tribe (no research)" and "new arrivals (no research)" for your own scenarios (scenario editor, Player faction). - The copies inherit from HSK's originals, so HSK updates carry over. The originals are unchanged.
Research gates: 12 buildings that HSK 1.7 or its addons leave without any research would otherwise be buildable on day one. They now need the research of their closest HSK peer: spike trap, both autoloaders, illumination turret (Watcher 2.5), hand assembling workbench, active gas cleaning (Watcher 2.5), Rimatomics PPC/PPHC, rooftop turbine vent, salt mine, silage pile, leatherworker table. This also applies to normal HSK starts, where you usually have that research already.
First steps with no research: build a primitive research table, then research Basic knowledge of craft and Food Prep.
